legend: Vova has won n$$$n$$$ trophies in different competitions. Each trophy is either golden or silver. The trophies are arranged in a row.

The beauty of the arrangement is the length of the longest subsegment consisting of golden trophies. Vova wants to swap two trophies (not necessarily adjacent ones) to make the arrangement as beautiful as possible — that means, to maximize the length of the longest such subsegment.
Help Vova! Tell him the maximum possible beauty of the arrangement if he is allowed to do at most one swap.
input: The first line contains one integer n$$$n$$$ (2≤n≤105$$$2 \le n \le 10^5$$$) — the number of trophies.
The second line contains n$$$n$$$ characters, each of them is either G or S. If the i$$$i$$$-th character is G, then the i$$$i$$$-th trophy is a golden one, otherwise it's a silver trophy.
output: Print the maximum possible length of a subsegment of golden trophies, if Vova is allowed to do at most one swap.
note: In the first example Vova has to swap trophies with indices 4$$$4$$$ and 10$$$10$$$. Thus he will obtain the sequence "GGGGGGGSGS", the length of the longest subsegment of golden trophies is 7$$$7$$$.
In the second example Vova can make no swaps at all. The length of the longest subsegment of golden trophies in the sequence is 4$$$4$$$.
In the third example Vova cannot do anything to make the length of the longest subsegment of golden trophies in the sequence greater than 0$$$0$$$.

legend.ai: Vova 在不同的比赛中赢得了 n$$$n$$$ 个奖杯。每个奖杯要么是金色的，要么是银色的。这些奖杯排成一行。
排列的美丽程度定义为由金色奖杯组成的最长子段的长度。Vova 想要交换两个奖杯（不一定相邻），使排列尽可能美观，也就是说，最大化最长此类子段的长度。
请帮助 Vova！如果允许他至多进行一次交换，请告诉他排列美丽程度的最大可能值。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 n$$$n$$$(2≤n≤105$$$2 \le n \le 10^5$$$)，表示奖杯的数量。
第二行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个字符，每个字符要么是 G，要么是 S。如果第 i$$$i$$$ 个字符是 G，那么第 i$$$i$$$ 个奖杯就是金奖杯，否则就是银奖杯。

output.ai: 输出在至多进行一次交换的情况下，金奖杯连续子段的最大可能长度。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，Vova 需要交换下标为 4$$$4$$$ 和 10$$$10$$$ 的奖杯。这样他将得到序列 "GGGGGGGSGS"，金奖杯最长连续子段的长度为 7$$$7$$$。
在第二个样例中，Vova 可以完全不进行交换。序列中金奖杯最长连续子段的长度为 4$$$4$$$。
在第三个样例中，无论 Vova 做什么，都无法使序列中金奖杯最长连续子段的长度大于 0$$$0$$$。
